name: Gabatarwa ga Machine Learning (Koyon Na'ura)
objectives: Ba tare da rubutattun bayanai ba, bayyana mene ne machine learning da gane ko aiki classification ne ko regression, da bayani daidai, da aƙalla ayyuka 4 cikin 5 da aka rarraba daidai

Idan aka ba ku matsalar hasashe, yin ƙaramin dataset mai features masu ma'ana da label, da duba shi don gibi, da features da ke shafar amsar, ginshiƙin label ɗaya, da aƙalla gibi ɗaya mai yiwuwa da aka ambata
Idan aka ba ku dataset da sakamakon gwajin model, bayyana dalilin da yasa ake raba bayanai zuwa training set da test set, da lissafin daidaito, da daidaito daidai har zuwa cikakken kaso mafi kusa
A Google Colab da scikit-learn, loda dataset na atisaye da bayyana layukansa, features da labels, kuna ambaton yawan layuka da ginshiƙai da ma'anar label
Idan aka ba ku dataset na iris, raba bayanai, horar da decision tree, da buga daidaitonsa a kan test set, code yana gudana ba tare da kuskure ba, kuma an buga daidaiton

Idan aka ba ku models biyu da aka horar, kwatanta daidaitonsu a gwaji, hasashen sabon misali, da rubuta iyaka ɗaya ta model ɗin da kuka zaɓa, kuna zaɓar model da dalili, kuma kuna ambaton iyaka ta gaske

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Yadda na'urori ke koyo

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Mene ne machine learning
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 4
Manufa: Bayyana machine learning da kalmominku, da gane shi a rayuwar yau da kullum.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ba tare da rubutattun bayanai ba, za ku iya bayyana mene ne machine learning da gane ko aiki classification ne ko regression, da bayani daidai, da aƙalla ayyuka 4 cikin 5 da aka rarraba daidai.
A shirye-shirye na yau da kullum, mutum ne yake rubuta dokoki. A machine learning (ML), kuna ba kwamfuta misalai da yawa tare da amsoshi daidai, ita kuma tana nemo dokokin da kanta. Sakamakon ana kiransa model.
Misalai na yau da kullum: imel ɗinku yana koyon yadda spam yake kama daga miliyoyin imel da aka yi wa alama. Manhajar waƙa tana ba da shawarar waƙoƙi daga abin da mutane kamarku suka saurara. Manhajar taswira tana hasashen cunkoso daga tafiye-tafiyen da suka gabata.
Ayyuka biyu da aka saba: classification yana sa abubuwa cikin rukunoni (spam ko ba spam, wane irin fure). Regression yana hasashen lamba (farashin gida, minti nawa kafin bas ta zo). Idan misalan suna zuwa da amsoshi, ana kiransa supervised learning, kuma shi ne abin da wannan kwas ɗin yake koyarwa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Machine learning (ML): kwamfutoci suna nemo tsari a cikin misalai maimakon bin dokokin da mutum ya rubuta.
- Model: abin da ML yake samarwa: tarin tsare-tsaren da aka koya da ke yin hasashe.
- Classification: hasashen rukuni ko nau'i.
- Regression: hasashen lamba.
- Supervised learning: koyo daga misalai da ke zuwa da amsoshi daidai.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta manhajoji uku da kuke amfani da su waɗanda wataƙila suna amfani da machine learning. Ga kowanne, ku rubuta abin da yake hasashe, da ko classification ne (rukuni) ko regression (lamba).
Yanzu za ku iya bayyana mene ne machine learning da bambance classification da regression.

check.q: A machine learning, mene ne model?
options: Jerin dokokin da mutum ya rubuta da hannu
Sakamakon kwamfuta ta nemo tsari a cikin misalai
check.why: Model shi ne abin da kwamfuta ke samarwa bayan ta nemo tsari a cikin misalai.

check.q: Wani shago yana son ya rarraba imel na abokan ciniki zuwa "ƙorafi" ko "tambaya". Wane irin aiki za ku kira wannan?
check.why: Sa abubuwa cikin rukunoni classification ne; hasashen lamba regression ne.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Bayanai: features da labels
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Gina ƙaramin dataset mai features da label.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku matsalar hasashe, za ku iya yin ƙaramin dataset mai features masu ma'ana da label, da duba shi don gibi, da features da ke shafar amsar, ginshiƙin label ɗaya, da aƙalla gibi ɗaya mai yiwuwa da aka ambata.
ML yana koyo daga bayanai (data), yawanci tebur. Kowane layi misali ɗaya ne. Ginshiƙan da ke bayyana misalin su ne features. Ginshiƙin da ke da amsar da kuke son hasashe shi ne label.
Misali: don hasashen ko bas za ta makara, kowane layi tafiya ɗaya ne. Features za su iya zama lokacin rana, ranar mako, da ko an yi ruwan sama. Label shi ne ta makara ko ta zo a kan lokaci.
Features masu kyau abubuwa ne da ke shafar amsar da gaske. Layuka da yawa yawanci suna taimakawa. Dole ne bayanan su kasance masu adalci kuma cikakku: idan kun tattara tafiye-tafiyen ranakun aiki kawai, model ɗin ba zai yi kyau a ƙarshen mako ba. Model ba zai fi bayanansa kyau ba.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku yanke abin da kuke son hasashe: wannan shi ne label ɗinku.
- Ku rubuta abubuwan da za su iya shafar sa: waɗannan su ne features ɗinku.
- Ku yi tebur mai layi ɗaya ga kowane misali.
- Ku cika aƙalla layuka 10 daga rayuwa ta gaske.
- Ku duba: shin wasu nau'ikan misalai ba su nan?
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Dataset: tarin misalai, yawanci tebur.
- Feature: ginshiƙi da ke bayyana misali, ana amfani da shi don yin hasashe.
- Label: ginshiƙin amsa da model yake koyon hasashe.
- Son kai a bayanai (bias in data): idan bayanai sun bar wasu rukunoni ko sun ƙirga su fiye da kima, don haka model ɗin ya zama marar adalci ko kuskure a gare su.
Gwada yanzu: Ku zaɓi abin da za ku iya hasashe daga rayuwar yau da kullum, kamar ko za ku gaji bayan atisaye ko ko shago zai cika da mutane. Ku yi tebur mai features biyu ko uku da label, ku cika layuka 10.
Yanzu za ku iya zaɓar label da features masu amfani, da gina ƙaramin dataset.

check.q: A tebur na bayanai, mene ne features?
options: Ginshiƙan da ke bayyana kowane misali
check.why: Features suna bayyana misalin; label shi ne amsar da za a yi hasashe.

check.q: Kun tattara bayanai kan ɗaliban da ke gama aikin gida, amma daga aji ɗaya kawai. Me za ku yi kafin horo?
options: Ku horar nan take; aji ɗaya ya isa ga kowa
Ku tattara bayanai daga ƙarin azuzuwa don model ɗin ya yi adalci ga sauran ɗalibai
Ku yi amfani da layuka biyar na farko kawai
check.why: Bayanai daga rukuni ɗaya za su iya sa model ya yi rauni ko rashin adalci ga wasu.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Horo da gwaji: shin model ɗin yana da kyau?
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Raba bayanai zuwa training set da test set, da auna daidaito.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku dataset da sakamakon gwajin model, za ku iya bayyana dalilin da yasa ake raba bayanai zuwa training set da test set, da lissafin daidaito, da daidaito daidai har zuwa cikakken kaso mafi kusa.
Horo (training) shi ne lokacin da model yake nazarin misalai don nemo tsari. Amma model da ya haddace misalansa kawai zai iya bayyana kamar cikakke, kuma ya kasa a kan sababbi. Ana kiran wannan overfitting, kamar ɗalibin da ya haddace amsoshin jarabawar bara.
Don haka kuna ajiye wasu bayanai a gefe. Training set (sau da yawa kusan kashi 75 zuwa 80 na layuka) ana amfani da shi don koyo. Test set (sauran) ana ɓoye shi har ƙarshe, ana amfani da shi don duba model a kan misalan da bai taɓa gani ba.
Daidaito (accuracy) shi ne kason misalan gwaji da ya samu daidai. Daidai 18 cikin 20 kashi 90 ne. Koyaushe ku tambayi mene ne asarar kuskure: shawarar waƙa marar daidai ba matsala ba ce, amma faɗakarwar zamba da aka rasa matsala ce.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku gauraya layukanku.
- Ku sa kusan kashi 75 a training set.
- Ku ajiye sauran a matsayin test set, kuma kada ku duba shi.
- Ku nemo tsari (doka) daga training set kaɗai.
- Ku yi amfani da shi a kan test set, ku ƙirga nawa ya samu daidai.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Horo (training): model yana koyon tsari daga misalai.
- Training set: layukan da ake amfani da su don koyo.
- Test set: layukan da aka ajiye a gefe don duba model a kan sababbin misalai.
- Overfitting: idan model ya haddace bayanan horonsa kuma ya yi rauni a kan sababbin bayanai.
- Daidaito (accuracy): kason hasashen da suka yi daidai.
Gwada yanzu: Ku ɗauki teburinku mai layuka 10 daga Darasi na 2. Ku rufe layuka 2 na ƙarshe. Daga 8 na farko, ku rubuta doka ɗaya mai sauƙi (misali "idan an yi ruwan sama, bas za ta makara"). Ku gwada dokar a kan layuka 2 da aka ɓoye, ku lissafa daidaiton.
Yanzu za ku iya raba bayanai zuwa training set da test set, da lissafin daidaito.

options: Idan model ya yi ƙanƙanta sosai
Idan bayanan gwaji sun yi yawa
Idan model ya haddace misalan horonsa kuma ya kasa a kan sababbi
check.why: Overfitting kamar haddace amsoshin jarabawar bara ne.

check.q: Wani model na zamba ya sami daidaito 95%, amma abubuwan da ya rasa zamba ce ta gaske. Me za ku tambaya a gaba?
options: Za mu iya tsallake test set?
Za mu iya horarwa a kan test set?
check.why: Koyaushe ku tambayi asarar kuskure; faɗakarwar zamba da aka rasa tana da muhimmanci sosai.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Horar da model ɗinku na farko a Colab

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Loda dataset da scikit-learn
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Loda dataset na atisaye a Colab da duba features da labels ɗinsa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A Google Colab da scikit-learn, za ku iya loda dataset na atisaye da bayyana layukansa, features da labels, kuna ambaton yawan layuka da ginshiƙai da ma'anar label.
scikit-learn library ne na Python kyauta don machine learning, kuma ya riga ya kasance a Google Colab. Yana zuwa da ƙananan datasets na atisaye. Dataset na iris yana da furanni 150. Kowace tana da features huɗu (tsawo da faɗin sassa biyu na furen, a santimita) da label: ɗaya daga cikin nau'o'i uku.
Ku loda shi da: from sklearn.datasets import load_iris, sannan iris = load_iris(). Features suna cikin iris.data, labels kuma suna cikin iris.target. iris.feature_names da iris.target_names suna faɗa muku ma'anar ginshiƙan da labels.
Koyaushe ku duba bayananku kafin horo: layuka nawa, mene ne ginshiƙan, da wasu layukan misali. iris.data.shape yana faɗa muku layuka da ginshiƙai: (150, 4).
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe sabon notebook a colab.research.google.com.
- Ku gudanar da: from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
- Ku gudanar da: iris = load_iris()
- Ku buga iris.data.shape, iris.feature_names da iris.target_names.
- Ku buga layuka uku na farko: print(iris.data[:3], iris.target[:3])
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- scikit-learn: library na Python kyauta don machine learning, ana shigo da shi a matsayin sklearn.
- Dataset na iris: sanannen dataset na atisaye mai furanni 150 a nau'o'i uku.
- shape: yawan layuka da ginshiƙai a cikin bayanai.
- X da y: sunayen da aka saba: X don features, y don labels.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- scikit-learn: Yadda ake farawa (Getting Started)
- Google Colab: Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi (Frequently Asked Questions)
Gwada yanzu: Ku loda dataset na iris a Colab. Ku buga shape, sunayen features huɗu, sunayen nau'o'i uku, da layuka biyar na farko tare da labels ɗinsu. Ku rubuta wace lamba ke nufin wane nau'i.
Yanzu za ku iya loda dataset a Colab da bayyana features, labels da girmansa.

check.q: A dataset na iris na scikit-learn, me iris.target yake riƙe?
check.why: iris.target yana riƙe labels; iris.data yana riƙe features.

check.q: Kun gama loda sabon dataset. Me za ku yi kafin horar da model?
options: Ku horar nan take ba tare da dubawa ba
Ku duba shape, sunayen ginshiƙai da wasu layukan misali
check.why: Koyaushe ku duba bayananku kafin horo.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Horo da gwajin decision tree
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Raba bayanai, horar da decision tree, da auna daidaitonsa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku dataset na iris, za ku iya raba bayanai, horar da decision tree, da buga daidaitonsa a kan test set, code yana gudana ba tare da kuskure ba, kuma an buga daidaiton.
Decision tree (bishiyar yanke shawara) yana koyon jerin tambayoyin e-ko-a'a, kamar zanen matakai (flowchart): "Shin furen petal ya gajarta da 2.5 cm? To nau'i na 0 ne." Yana da sauƙin bayani, shi ya sa yake model na farko mai kyau.
Kowane model na scikit-learn yana aiki iri ɗaya: ku ƙirƙira shi, ku yi masa fit a kan bayanan horo, sannan ku yi predict a kan sababbin bayanai. Code ɗin: X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True). X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42). model = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42). model.fit(X_train, y_train).
Sannan ku gwada shi: predictions = model.predict(X_test) da print(accuracy_score(y_test, predictions)). random_state=42 kawai yana gyara gaurayawar don ku sami sakamako iri ɗaya duk lokacin da kuka gudanar da shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku shigo da: from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
- Ku shigo da: from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
- Ku shigo da: from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
- Ku raba da train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42).
- Ku ƙirƙiri model, ku kira model.fit(X_train, y_train), sannan ku yi predict a kan X_test ku buga daidaiton.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Decision tree: model da ke koyon zanen matakai na tambayoyin e-ko-a'a.
- fit: horar da model a kan bayanai.
- predict: amfani da model da aka horar don tsammanin labels na sababbin bayanai.
- train_test_split: kayan aikin scikit-learn da ke raba bayanai zuwa training set da test set.
- random_state: lambar da ke gyara gaurayawa ta yadda sakamako zai maimaitu.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- scikit-learn: Yadda ake farawa (Getting Started)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta ku gudanar da cikakken code na decision tree a Colab. Ku buga daidaiton. Sannan ku canja test_size zuwa 0.5, ku sake gudanarwa, ku rubuta ko daidaito ya ƙaru ko ya ragu.
Yanzu za ku iya raba bayanai, horar da decision tree da fit, yin hasashe da shi, da auna daidaito.

check.q: Me yasa decision tree model na farko ne mai kyau?
options: Yana da sauƙin bayani, kamar zanen matakai na tambayoyin e-ko-a'a
Yana aiki a kan furanni kawai
check.why: Ana iya karanta tambayoyin decision tree kamar zanen matakai.

check.q: Kun horar da model ɗinku kuma kuna son ku duba shi. Wane layi za ku gudanar?
check.why: Ku yi predict a kan test set, sannan ku kwatanta da labels na gaskiya don samun daidaito.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Kwatanta models da sanin iyakokinsu
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Horar da model na biyu, kwatanta shi da na farko, hasashen sabon misali, da ambaton iyaka.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku models biyu da aka horar, za ku iya kwatanta daidaitonsu a gwaji, hasashen sabon misali, da rubuta iyaka ɗaya ta model ɗin da kuka zaɓa, kuna zaɓar model da dalili, kuma kuna ambaton iyaka ta gaske.
Ba kasafai ake samun model ɗaya cikakke ba, don haka kuna gwada fiye da ɗaya. k-nearest neighbors (KNN) yana hasashe ta hanyar nemo misalai k mafi kama a cikin bayanan horo, sannan ya yi ƙuri'a. Ku ƙirƙira shi da KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5) daga sklearn.neighbors; yana amfani da matakan fit da predict iri ɗaya.
Ku kwatanta models biyun a kan test set ɗaya. Don hasashen sabuwar fure ɗaya, ku ba model list a cikin list: model.predict([[5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2]]). Yana mayar da lambar nau'in; iris.target_names yana mayar da ita suna.
Ku san iyakoki. Waɗannan models suna sanin waɗannan nau'o'i uku da waɗannan ma'auni huɗu kawai: ku nuna musu fure ta wardi (rose), za su ci gaba da ce mata iris. Ƙaramin test set zai iya sa daidaito ya bayyana fiye ko ƙasa da yadda yake. Kuma da bayanan mutane na gaske, ku duba cewa model yana aiki da adalci ga kowane rukuni kafin kowa ya dogara da shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku shigo da: from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
- Ku ƙirƙiri knn = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5) ku yi masa fit a kan bayanan horo iri ɗaya.
- Ku buga makin daidaito biyun.
- Ku yi hasashen sabuwar fure ɗaya da model mafi kyau: model.predict([[5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2]])
- Ku rubuta wane model za ku zaɓa da iyaka ɗaya.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- k-nearest neighbors (KNN): model da ke hasashe ta ƙuri'ar misalan horo mafi kama.
- n_neighbors: misalai masu kama nawa KNN yake dubawa (wato k).
- Iyaka (limit): halin da model ba zai iya sarrafawa da kyau ba.
- Adalci (fairness): model yana aiki daidai wa daida ga kowane rukunin mutanen da yake shafa.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- scikit-learn: Yadda ake farawa (Getting Started)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: a notebook ɗaya, ku horar da decision tree da model na KNN a kan rabuwa ɗaya, ku buga daidaito biyun, ku yi hasashen nau'in furen [6.0, 2.9, 4.5, 1.5] da model mafi kyau ku buga sunansa, sannan ku rubuta jimloli biyu kan wane model kuka zaɓa da iyaka ɗaya da yake da ita.
Yanzu za ku iya horarwa, gwadawa da kwatanta models biyu, yin hasashe, da bayyana iyakokin model.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Loda da raba bayanai Bayanan ba su loda ba, ko an gwada model a kan bayanan horo. An loda bayanan iris kuma an raba su zuwa training set da test set da train_test_split. Yana kuma buga shape na kowane set kuma yana bayanin rabuwar. An horar da models biyu kuma an gwada su An horar da model ɗaya kawai, ko daidaito ba ya nan. An horar da decision tree da model na KNN, kuma an buga daidaiton gwajin kowanne. Yana kuma gwada wata ƙima ta biyu ta n_neighbors kuma yana kwatantawa. Hasashe ga sabuwar fure Babu hasashe, ko shigarwar tana da siffa marar daidai. Model mafi kyau yana hasashen sabuwar fure ɗaya kuma an buga sunan nau'in. Yana kuma bayanin dalilin da yasa hasashen yake da ma'ana daga ma'aunin. Zaɓi da iyakoki Jimloli biyun ba su nan, ko ba a ambaci iyaka ta gaske ba. Jimloli biyu: wane model da dalili, da iyaka ɗaya ta gaske. Yana kuma ambaton asarar kurakurai ko adalci ga bayanan mutane. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: Me n_neighbors=5 yake nufi a model na KNN?
options: Yana duba misalan horo 5 mafi kama ya yi ƙuri'a
Yana hasashen furanni 5 a lokaci ɗaya
check.why: KNN yana hasashe ta ƙuri'ar misalai k mafi kama.

check.q: Model ɗinku ya yi hasashen nau'i na 0 ga sabuwar fure. Ta yaya za ku mayar da wannan lambar suna?
check.why: iris.target_names yana mayar da lambar nau'i zuwa suna.
